subject: pkg:pypi/pandas
claim: DataFrame.append and Series.append were removed in pandas 2.0; concat is the documented replacement.
expectation: Calling DataFrame.append on a 2.x release raises AttributeError, and the 2.0.0 release notes list the removal with concat named instead.

subject: pkg:pypi/numpy
claim: The alias np.float raises an error from numpy 1.24, where its earlier deprecation expired.
expectation: Evaluating np.float on 1.24 or later raises rather than returning a type.

subject: pkg:npm/node-fetch
claim: From version 3 the package is ESM-only and cannot be loaded with require(); version 2 remains CommonJS-compatible.
expectation: require('node-fetch') on a v3 install fails, while the same call on v2 succeeds.

subject: pkg:npm/chalk
claim: Chalk 5 is published as pure ESM and cannot be loaded with require(); CommonJS consumers are directed to version 4.
expectation: require('chalk') fails on a v5 install and succeeds on v4.
note: verified: chalk readme / v5.0.0 release notes

subject: pkg:npm/express
claim: Express 5 declares a minimum Node.js engine of 18 in its package manifest.
expectation: The published package.json for express 5.x carries an engines.node value of >= 18.

subject: pkg:pypi/sqlalchemy
claim: Passing a bare SQL string to Connection.execute raises in SQLAlchemy 2.0; textual SQL requires text() or exec_driver_sql.
expectation: conn.execute('SELECT 1') raises on a 2.x release rather than returning rows.

subject: pkg:pypi/urllib3
claim: urllib3 2.x supports only OpenSSL 1.1.1 or newer and raises ImportError against an ssl module built on older OpenSSL.
expectation: Importing urllib3 2.x where ssl reports OpenSSL 1.0.2 raises ImportError naming the version requirement.

subject: tool:ffmpeg
claim: With no explicit map option, automatic stream selection picks the highest-resolution video stream and the audio stream with the most channels.
expectation: Given several video streams of differing resolution and no map option, the highest-resolution one is selected.

subject: tool:curl
claim: HTTP 3xx redirects are not followed unless the location option is supplied.
expectation: A request to a URL returning 302 emits the redirect response rather than the final target's body, absent -L.

subject: tool:sqlite
claim: The default journaling mode is DELETE; write-ahead logging must be enabled explicitly via pragma.
expectation: PRAGMA journal_mode on a newly created database returns delete rather than wal.

subject: spec:ietf/rfc9110
claim: RFC 9110 obsoletes RFC 7231.
expectation: The RFC Editor entry for 9110 lists 7231 among the RFCs it obsoletes.

subject: spec:ietf/rfc8259
claim: RFC 8259 requires JSON exchanged between systems outside a closed ecosystem to be encoded in UTF-8.
expectation: The specification text states that such JSON text MUST be encoded using UTF-8.

subject: pkg:pypi/pydantic
claim: BaseModel.dict is deprecated in pydantic v2 in favour of model_dump.
expectation: Calling .dict() on a v2 model emits a deprecation warning and the migration guide maps it to model_dump.

subject: pkg:pypi/black
claim: Black's default target line length is 88 characters.
expectation: Formatting with no line-length flag wraps at 88 columns.

subject: tool:jq
claim: jq pretty-prints its JSON output by default; compact single-line output requires the compact-output flag.
expectation: Piping an object through jq with no flags yields indented multi-line output.

subject: tool:rsync
claim: A trailing slash on the source path copies the directory's contents without recreating the directory itself at the destination.
expectation: rsync src/ dst/ places src's children directly in dst, while rsync src dst creates dst/src.

subject: pkg:npm/react
claim: From React 17 the new JSX transform allows JSX without importing React into scope.
expectation: A component file using JSX but no React import compiles under the new transform.
note: verified: React new JSX transform post

subject: pkg:npm/typescript
claim: When compilerOptions omits strict entirely, the compiler behaves as if strict were true.
expectation: An untyped function parameter raises TS7006 under a tsconfig that never mentions strict.
note: verified empirically with tsc this session

subject: pkg:npm/node
claim: The global fetch stopped being marked experimental in Node.js 21.
expectation: The Node.js globals documentation history records fetch as no longer experimental at v21.0.0.

subject: pkg:pypi/pip
claim: PEP 668 specifies that installing into an externally managed interpreter outside a virtual environment fails unless an override flag is passed.
expectation: pip install outside a venv on an interpreter carrying the marker exits with an error naming the override.

subject: pkg:pypi/uv
claim: uv's pip interface installs into a virtual environment by default and needs an explicit flag or python path to touch the system interpreter.
expectation: uv pip install with no active venv and no --system does not modify the system interpreter.

subject: tool:docker
claim: A shell-form CMD runs the process under a shell rather than as PID 1, so it does not receive Unix signals.
expectation: A container built with shell-form CMD does not deliver SIGTERM to the named executable on stop.

subject: spec:ietf/rfc9111
claim: RFC 9111 obsoletes RFC 7234.
expectation: The RFC Editor entry for 9111 states that it obsoletes 7234.

subject: spec:semver/2.0.0
claim: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 requires the MAJOR version to increment for any backward incompatible change to the public API.
expectation: The specification text states MAJOR MUST be incremented when backward incompatible changes are introduced.

subject: spec:ietf/rfc7519
claim: RFC 7519 (JSON Web Token) is updated by RFC 8725.
expectation: The RFC Editor entry for 7519 lists 8725 among the RFCs updating it.

subject: spec:ietf/rfc6455
claim: RFC 6455 (The WebSocket Protocol) is updated by RFC 8441.
expectation: The RFC Editor entry for 6455 lists 8441 among the RFCs updating it.

subject: pkg:pypi/fastapi
claim: FastAPI serves interactive documentation at /docs and /redoc unless those URLs are set to None.
expectation: A plain FastAPI() application responds 200 at /docs with no extra configuration.

subject: tool:git

expectation: The git-init manual describes the fallback name as currently master, noting it changes at Git 3.0.

subject: pkg:pypi/requests
claim: requests applies no default timeout; a call omitting the timeout argument can block indefinitely.
expectation: The documentation states no timeout is applied by default and advises passing one explicitly.
